intent.raw: Want to do this as workflow reflect tool, we can use this as way of validating system performance in breaking concepts and work in coherent units, if possible tying this to some metric that could be read and showed as performance of the agentic systems. Add this to current strategy: how can we redefine, improve, correct the definitions in CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md with this, what SCU really represents, and what DCI has in relation to SCU and the Craft definitions?
intent.objective: Refine, through the canonical ten-stage loop, (1) a non-executed design for a Decomposition Coherence Index (DCI) computed from existing observability telemetry and surfaced by workflow-reflect, and (2) a candidate redline revision of CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md that redefines what SCU really represents, corrects the entropy definition using the four-way split and prior-art verdict, and states DCI's relation to SCU and the Craft formal model — resolving Open Questions #3/#4 and residue R1/R3 — with an explicit residue-not-entropy honesty boundary and a real-telemetry backtest, without editing the canonical Craft definition or sigil packages (the redline routes through a decision-gate).
intent.operator_sentence: Read the residue the system already emits, turn it into a coherence score, and use it to honestly redefine what SCU is and where DCI sits in the Craft model.

route_menu.context_hint: Several metric definitions could serve as the DCI; the design stage records a route decision over candidate metrics computable from existing telemetry.

items.label: Tournament across three DCI definitions
items.description: Compare residue-rate, composite-bundle, and recomposition-success definitions on real telemetry under a pareto gate.

items.label: Single metric: residue-rate only
items.description: Use only the cheapest already-emitted proxy (status + quality_bar + gaps); fastest but least interpretable as a coherence decomposition.

items.label: Composite-bundle first
items.description: Build the typed E_energy/R_rel/A_att sub-score metric first; richer but needs the gap-category taxonomy mapped before backtest.

technique_overlays.trigger: Every refine run preserves the canonical ordered loop with safe handoffs and observability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each non-first stage consumes a prior handoff, stages keep owner boundaries, and trace events group by dispatch_id.

technique_overlays.trigger: The metric builds directly on prior runs (entropy search, SCU experiment, prior-art audit) and on the existing observability signal store.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Prior verdicts and the real telemetry store are cited by path; the residue-not-entropy boundary is carried forward, not re-derived.

technique_overlays.trigger: Three candidate DCI definitions (residue-rate, composite-bundle, recomposition-success) must be compared on real telemetry before one is chosen.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design stage declares metric roles, a pareto criterion over computability, interpretability, and gaming-resistance, and a recomposition proof into the workflow-reflect lens.

technique_overlays.trigger: The chosen metric must be backtested on the real signal store before any workflow-reflect integration is planned.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The repair stage computes the candidate metrics over sigil-invocations.jsonl, checks discrimination and gaming-resistance, and names the failure interpretation if the metric does not separate clean from residue-heavy units.

technique_overlays.trigger: The Craft redefinition must hold operational honesty (SCU = measured residue minimum, prior art cited) against the doc's universal-physics horizon without collapsing either.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The redefinition preserves a source-honest operational reading and the doc's philosophical-horizon reading until synthesis, and produces a candidate redline, not a canonical edit.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the observability envelope schema cannot be read.
Flag if the real signal store is unavailable for a backtest.

steps.name: Invoke Define the DCI objective and boundary
stop_conditions: Block if the define claims to measure pre-translation entropy rather than realized residue.
Flag if the define names a signal the observability package does not emit.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review of the define
stop_conditions: Block if the metric is gameable by simply emitting fewer gaps.
Flag if unit-size normalization is left implicit.

steps.name: Refine research decision
stop_conditions: Record no-research: the prior-art audit is complete and local telemetry is sufficient.
Flag if a metric-validity gap requires external method confirmation.

steps.name: Distill the coherent measurable unit and signal set
convergence_criteria: The unit of measure is one sigil invocation, with the telemetry fields that define its residue and recomposition named.
A unit-size proxy (e.g. files_changed count) is selected so DCI can be read against unit size.
Rejected signal choices are recorded with the reason they were excluded.
stop_conditions: Block if no emitted signal can serve as the unit boundary.
Flag if the unit-size proxy is not actually present in the telemetry.

steps.name: Invoke Design DCI candidates via metric tournament
convergence_criteria: Each metric role gives a formula over named telemetry fields, a [0,100] normalization, and a gaming-resistance argument.
A pareto gate ranks the candidates on computability-from-emitted-signals, interpretability, and gaming-resistance.
The winning metric proves recomposition into a workflow-reflect lens (per-sigil, per-window, and vs unit-size views).
stop_conditions: Block if a candidate requires signals the package does not emit.
Flag if the tournament collapses to one candidate without recording the comparison.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review of the DCI design
stop_conditions: Block if the metric rewards under-reporting gaps (Goodhart risk) without a countermeasure.
Flag if DCI conflates unit difficulty with decomposition quality.

steps.name: Distill Repair via backtest on real telemetry
stop_conditions: Block if the metric cannot be computed over the real sigil-invocations.jsonl.
Flag and record as assessment failure if the metric does not separate completed-clean units from blocked or gap-heavy units.

steps.name: Invoke Plan the workflow-reflect integration (non-executed)
stop_conditions: Block if the plan implies editing canonical sigil packages or the Craft definition instead of proposing configs and a candidate redline.
Flag if the plan lacks a gaming-resistance and a trend/readout view, or if the redefinition plan does not name the exact CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md sections to revise.

steps.name: Final Interrogation, Craft redefinition dialectic, and Refine synthesis
convergence_criteria: The author role states the operationally honest redefinition (SCU = measured residue-density minimum; entropy split; DCI = post-translation estimator of R); the guardian role preserves the doc's philosophical-horizon framing.
Synthesis produces a candidate redline naming the exact CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md sections to change and resolving Open Questions #3/#4 and residue R1/R3.
The redline cites prior art and claims no novelty; it is a candidate routed to a decision-gate, not a canonical edit.
stop_conditions: Block if RESULT.md is synthesized from the route instead of the backtest and stage artifacts.
Block if the redefinition edits CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md instead of producing a candidate redline.
Flag if any open residue lacks an owner or next route.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The design stage is a tournament across three candidate DCI definitions, each needing an independent formula and gaming-resistance argument, plus a backtest reviewer who computes them on the real telemetry without a designer's bias.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One designer per metric keeps residue-rate, composite-bundle, and recomposition-success framings independent so the pareto comparison is fair; a separate backtest reviewer keeps the empirical check honest.
context: The prior-art audit established residue-rate (Proxy C) is the cheapest already-emitted proxy; the composite and recomposition framings are richer but unproven on this telemetry.
A single author would likely favor whichever metric is easiest to compute.

roles.purpose: Design the residue-rate DCI from execution.status, quality_bar_status, and workflow_gaps severity.
Design the typed composite DCI mapping gap categories to E_energy / R_rel / A_att sub-scores.
Design the recomposition-success DCI from output_contract_drift and downstream reopen/retry signals.
Compute the candidate metrics over the real sigil-invocations.jsonl and test discrimination and gaming-resistance.
Draft the operationally honest redline: SCU as measured residue-density minimum, entropy split, DCI as post-translation estimator of R, with prior-art citations.
Preserve the Craft definition's philosophical-horizon framing and block over-reduction during the redefinition dialectic.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the DCI refine loop with three parallel metric designers (residue-rate, composite-bundle, recomposition-success) and a telemetry backtest reviewer over the real signal store, returning ranked design receipts and a backtest only?
receipt_requirements: metric formula over named telemetry fields and [0,100] normalization
gaming-resistance argument and backtest discrimination result

agents.residue: Residue-rate: computability 5/5; objective-weighted; weakness = zero-file observe units dominate, bimodal.
Composite quad: interpretability 5/5 but computability 2/5 (R_rel/A_att data-starved; 22 gap records).
Recomposition/reopen: strongest gaming-resistance in theory, but reopen proved inert on this store.
DCI discriminates (clean 100 vs residue 71.7, no overlap) as anomaly detector; reopen inert; residue not size-driven.
Redline: SCU = residue-density minimum (not size); entropy split; E latent, R measured, DCI estimator; resolves OQ3/4.
Guardrails: recomposition co-constraint; pre/post loop; size-as-symptom; tower-trigger + horizon preserved.

boundaries.contract: The winning DCI design is a candidate until the backtest on real telemetry supports discrimination and gaming-resistance.
The plan is a candidate metric and config proposal; integrating DCI into workflow-reflect and the observability package is owned by those capabilities, not this refine loop.
The Craft redefinition is a candidate redline routed through a decision-gate; applying it to CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md is a separate owner-approved task.

state_namespaces.write_policy: This refine run may write only inside its own run folder.
The signal store is read-only for this run; the backtest reads it and writes results only into the run folder.
No edits to workflow-reflect, observability, or sigil packages from this run; integration is a separate owner task.

promotion_splits.source: refine DCI design and backtest evidence
promotion_splits.target: canonical workflow-reflect metric, observability package, or Arcanum glossary
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage must name an available native capability handle before execution, or block with the missing handle.
Each runtime-backed stage must record a stage receipt artifact path or an explicit blocked reason before it is marked complete.

DCI must be computable only from signals the observability package actually emits, must be labeled a realized-residue coherence proxy rather than a measure of pre-translation entropy, and must name how it resists trivial gaming.
The selected metric must be backtested on the real signal store and must separate completed-clean units from blocked or gap-heavy units, or be recorded as an assessment failure.
Stages may propose a candidate metric and config but must not edit canonical workflow-reflect, observability, or sigil packages, or the Craft definition.

The Craft redefinition must be a candidate redline that cites prior art, claims no novelty, names the exact sections to change, and routes through a decision-gate; it must not edit CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md directly.
RESULT.md must be synthesized from the backtest and stage artifacts, not from the route artifact.

promotion_guardrails: Do not claim DCI measures pre-translation entropy; it measures realized residue as a coherence proxy.
Do not present the coherence-vs-unit-size curve as a novel law; it is a descriptive diagnostic over known prior art.
Do not edit canonical workflow-reflect, observability, or sigil packages from this run; integration is a separate owner task.
Do not ship a metric that rewards emitting fewer gaps; name and keep a gaming-resistance.
Do not edit CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md directly; produce a candidate redline and a decision-gate for the Craft definition owner.
Do not present the SCU/entropy redefinition as novel; cite the prior-art verdict and claim only operationalization.
Do not execute the metric-designer, backtest, or redefinition subagents without explicit operator approval.
